title: DerivedFacts
description: Output of skill scripts/chart_facts.py --json (facts_json) and consultation_context.derived_fact_ids. Parashari only. Id grammar: F.<group>.<field>, e.g. F.H7.lord, F.Sa.combust, F.yoga.GK-BPHS36.holds. Values are scalars or lists of scalars; null means the needed data was not supplied or the fact does not apply. Version the scheme in 'schema'.
